correctness.rationale: Exact 2×2 Gram eigenvalues reduce the event to almost aligned iid phases. Rotational invariance leaves L-1 independent angles; localization excludes other vanishing loci; a positive-definite Hessian matrix with determinant 1/L yields an exact ellipsoid-volume coefficient by dominated convergence. Layer cake yields the sharp integrability threshold. The Gaussian comparison follows from a gamma-distributed Schur complement. The attached verifier checks finite consequences, but the proof is analytic.
